messages:
Leah: Quick sync — we're aiming to publish the launch post for Dedicated autoscale and batching optimizations on Tue 2026-04-14 14:00 PT. Need final changelog, docs anchor, release window confirmation, and the short list of migration notes for customers. Who can confirm?

Jorge: I can confirm changelog. PR merged: https://github.com/redwood/infra/commit/9f2b4d3
Changelog top-line: 'Dedicated autoscale + batching reductions — up to 40% lower unit cost at steady traffic.'

Leah: Perfect. Arman, docs status?

Arman: Docs PR https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/412 ready for review. Anchor: /docs/dedicated/autoscale
Still need one small snippet on 'how to pin model versions' — I can add by EOD.

Leah: Great. Can we get an ops window? Tess?

Tess: Canary rollout scheduled 2026-04-14 13:00 PT (10% traffic), full rollout 14:00 PT if metrics look good. We'll monitor latency P50/P95 and error rate. Paging policy: if error_rate > 1% or p95 > 1.5s for 5m, automatic rollback.

Leah: Love the rollback rule. Sam — any notes for marketing copy or embargo?

Sam: Please hold embargo until 14:00 PT. Marketing will publish blog + tweet thread + webinar landing page at that time. I need the final one-line quote from Eng by 12:00 PT for the tweet.

Jorge: Tweet quote: "Autoscale + intelligent batching reduces steady-state token cost while keeping sub-100ms local latencies for most workloads." Can tweak.

Leah: Nice. Also: inbound leads — who owns routing? We'll have a gated webinar signup that should route to SSO/Growth.

Sam: Growth will own the webinar leads. Tag pipeline: 'autoscale-launch-2026'. Please add UTM params to webinar CTA.

Arman: Docs will include GTM snippet with UTM example.

Leah: Quick release checklist — please ack:
```
- [ ] Changelog link in announcement (Jorge)
- [ ] Docs anchor + migration snippet (Arman)
- [ ] Canary + rollback configured (Tess)
- [ ] Final quote for social (Jorge/Sam)
- [ ] Webinar landing + UTM (Sam/Growth)
- [ ] Support playbook updated (Leah)
```

Jorge: Ack — changelog done.

Arman: Ack — will add migration snippet by 11:30 PT.

Tess: Ack — monitoring + rollback in place, will post dashboards link in channel before canary.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: canary at 2026-04-14 13:00 PT, full rollout at 2026-04-14 14:00 PT. CI: green.

Leah: Thanks all. Final asks: put any last-minute blockers in this thread by 11:45 PT. Marketing will queue the post and un-schedule the embargo only after the 12:00 quote and docs PR merge.

Sam: Will confirm webinar form URL by 12:15 PT and drop in channel.

Jorge: If anyone needs the changelog excerpt for the blog, use:
> "Dedicated autoscale reduces steady-state cost up to 40% while preserving latency SLOs via adaptive batching and KV cache reuse."

Leah: Perfect. Closing — will follow up with final schedule and published links once live. :rocket:
